text_a: Keep at least three backup copies of every report.
text_b: Keep no fewer than three backup copies of every report.

text_a: Cada usuario puede abrir como máximo cinco tickets al día.
text_b: Cada usuario puede abrir como mínimo cinco tickets al día.
what_differs: maximum versus minimum number of tickets

text_a: O servidor deve ter no máximo dez usuários conectados ao mesmo tempo.
text_b: O servidor deve ter até dez usuários conectados ao mesmo tempo.

text_a: Each invoice attachment must be at most 5 MB.
text_b: Each invoice attachment must be at least 5 MB.
what_differs: upper limit changed to lower limit

text_a: Borra todos los archivos temporales excepto los del servidor de facturas.
text_b: Borra todos los archivos temporales salvo los del servidor de facturas.

text_a: Envie o relatório a todos os gerentes, exceto ao diretor financeiro.
text_b: Envie o relatório a todos os gerentes, inclusive ao diretor financeiro.
what_differs: except versus including the finance director

text_a: Do not restart the server unless the ticket is marked urgent.
text_b: Do not restart the server if the ticket is not marked urgent.
what_differs: the second text forbids restart in the non-urgent case but is silent otherwise; unless versus if-not scope shifts the condition

text_a: Archive every folder apart from the one named Payroll.
text_b: Archive all folders but the one named Payroll.

text_a: Somente o administrador pode apagar contas de usuários.
text_b: Apenas o administrador pode apagar contas de usuários.

text_a: Only the finance team may approve invoices.
text_b: The finance team may also approve invoices.
what_differs: only versus also: exclusivity removed

text_a: Solo el jefe de TI puede acceder al servidor de copias de seguridad.
text_b: Nadie más que el jefe de TI puede acceder al servidor de copias de seguridad.

text_a: Just export the file; do not edit it.
text_b: Solely export the file; do not edit it.
what_differs: just may mean merely or simply, so the nuance of solely is open

text_a: Do not share the admin password with anyone.
text_b: Never share the admin password with anyone.
what_differs: never may add a temporal strength beyond do not

text_a: No dejes ninguna sesión abierta al terminar el turno.
text_b: No dejes sesiones abiertas al terminar el turno.

text_a: Não envie o arquivo ao cliente antes da revisão.
text_b: Envie o arquivo ao cliente antes da revisão.
what_differs: negation dropped

text_a: Do not install any software without approval.
text_b: Don't install any software without approval.

text_a: Si el disco supera el 90 %, avisa al administrador.
text_b: Avisa al administrador si el disco supera el 90 %.

text_a: Call the vendor if the backup fails.
text_b: Call the vendor unless the backup fails.
what_differs: if versus unless inverts the condition

text_a: Reinicie o servidor a menos que haja usuários conectados.
text_b: Reinicie o servidor se não houver usuários conectados.

text_a: If the ticket is closed, the user must be notified.
text_b: If the user is notified, the ticket must be closed.
what_differs: condition and consequence swapped

text_a: Keep twenty daily backups on the server.
text_b: Keep 20 daily backups on the server.

text_a: Cada factura debe pesar menos de 1.000 KB.
text_b: Cada factura debe pesar menos de 1,000 KB.
what_differs: 1,000 could be one thousand or one in English notation, ambiguous in Spanish

text_a: A reunião será na sala 4B às dez horas.
text_b: A reunião será na sala 4-B às dez horas.

text_a: Limit each upload to 20 MB.
text_b: Limit each upload to 21 MB.
what_differs: 20 versus 21 MB

text_a: Mueve los archivos a la carpeta de 500 gigabytes.
text_b: Mueve los archivos a la carpeta de 500 GB.

text_a: Submit the report no later than Friday.
text_b: Submit the report by Friday at the latest.

text_a: Faça o backup antes da reunião de segunda-feira.
text_b: Faça o backup depois da reunião de segunda-feira.
what_differs: before versus after the meeting

text_a: Mantén el servidor apagado hasta las 8:00.
text_b: Mantén el servidor apagado antes de las 8:00.
what_differs: until versus before could both mean up to 8:00 but are phrased differently and the boundary is unclear

text_a: Pay the invoice by the 15th.
text_b: Pay the invoice before the 15th.
what_differs: by includes the 15th, before excludes it

text_a: Send the monthly report to the whole team.
text_b: Mail the monthly report to the whole team.

text_a: Elimina las cuentas inactivas cada mes.
text_b: Borra las cuentas inactivas cada mes.

text_a: Reinicie o servidor depois da atualização.
text_b: Desligue o servidor depois da atualização.
what_differs: restart versus shut down

text_a: Install the patch on all workstations.
text_b: Deploy the patch to all workstations.
what_differs: install and deploy may differ in who performs it and how

text_a: El administrador revisará los registros cada lunes.
text_b: Los registros serán revisados por el administrador cada lunes.

text_a: The auditor must approve every payment.
text_b: Every payment must be approved by the auditor.

text_a: O gerente deve aprovar o relatório do analista.
text_b: O analista deve aprovar o relatório do gerente.
what_differs: roles of manager and analyst swapped

text_a: After the backup finishes, delete the old logs.
text_b: Delete the old logs after the backup finishes.

text_a: Every user must change the password this month.
text_b: Each user must change the password this month.

text_a: Revisa todos los tickets abiertos antes del viernes.
text_b: Revisa algunos tickets abiertos antes del viernes.
what_differs: all versus some tickets

text_a: Não envie nenhum arquivo ao cliente.
text_b: Não envie qualquer arquivo ao cliente.
what_differs: qualquer can read as any whatsoever or as just any random file, ambiguous scope
